achievement_types_archived_check.name: achievement_types_archived_check
achievement_types_archived_check.value: ("achievement_types"."archived_at" IS NULL) = ("achievement_types"."archived_by" IS NULL) AND (NOT "achievement_types"."builtin" OR "achievement_types"."archived_at" IS NULL)

agent_caller_limits_target_check.name: agent_caller_limits_target_check
agent_caller_limits_target_check.value:
("agent_caller_limits"."target_kind" = 'workspace' AND "agent_caller_limits"."team_id" IS NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."channel_id" IS NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("agent_caller_limits"."target_kind" = 'team' AND "agent_caller_limits"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."channel_id" IS NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("agent_caller_limits"."target_kind" = 'channel' AND "agent_caller_limits"."team_id" IS NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("agent_caller_limits"."target_kind" = 'user' AND "agent_caller_limits"."team_id" IS NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."channel_id" IS NULL AND "agent_caller_limits"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

agent_engine_settings_permissions_check.name: agent_engine_settings_permissions_check
agent_engine_settings_permissions_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("agent_engine_settings"."permissions") = 'object'
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."permissions", 'strict $.keyvalue() ? (!(@.key == "allow" || @.key == "ask" || @.key == "deny"))')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."permissions", 'strict $.* ? (@.type() != "array")')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."permissions", 'strict $.* ? (@.size() > 64)')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."permissions", 'strict $.*[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."permissions", 'strict $.*[*] ? (@ == "" || @ like_regex "^(.{128}){2}." flag "s")')

agent_engine_settings_auto_mode_check.name: agent_engine_settings_auto_mode_check
agent_engine_settings_auto_mode_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("agent_engine_settings"."auto_mode") = 'object'
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."auto_mode", 'strict $.keyvalue() ? (!(@.key == "allow" || @.key == "soft_deny" || @.key == "hard_deny" || @.key == "environment"))')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."auto_mode", 'strict $.* ? (@.type() != "array")')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."auto_mode", 'strict $.* ? (@.size() > 64)')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."auto_mode", 'strict $.*[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
    AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_engine_settings"."auto_mode", 'strict $.*[*] ? (@ == "" || @ like_regex "^(.{128}){8}." flag "s")')

agent_mcp_settings_allowed_tools_check.name: agent_mcp_settings_allowed_tools_check
agent_mcp_settings_allowed_tools_check.value: jsonb_typeof("agent_mcp_settings"."allowed_tools") = 'array' AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_mcp_settings"."allowed_tools", 'strict $[*] ? (@.type() != "string")') AND ("agent_mcp_settings"."server" IS NOT NULL OR jsonb_array_length("agent_mcp_settings"."allowed_tools") = 0) AND ("agent_mcp_settings"."server" IS NULL OR NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_mcp_settings"."allowed_tools", 'strict $[*] ? (!(@ starts with $p) || @ == $p || @ like_regex "^.{129,}$")', jsonb_build_object('p', 'mcp__' || "agent_mcp_settings"."server" || '__')))

agent_mcp_settings_credential_refs_check.name: agent_mcp_settings_credential_refs_check
agent_mcp_settings_credential_refs_check.value: jsonb_typeof("agent_mcp_settings"."credential_refs") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("agent_mcp_settings"."credential_refs") <= 32 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_mcp_settings"."credential_refs", 'strict $[*] ? (@.type() != "string")') AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("agent_mcp_settings"."credential_refs", 'strict $[*] ? (!(@ like_regex "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]{0,127}$"))')

agent_releases_note_check.name: agent_releases_note_check
agent_releases_note_check.value: "agent_releases"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("agent_releases"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

agents_draft_check.name: agents_draft_check
agents_draft_check.value: ("agents"."draft_version_id" IS NULL) = ("agents"."draft_connection_id" IS NULL) AND ("agents"."draft_failure" IS NULL OR "agents"."draft_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

api_keys_agent_check.name: api_keys_agent_check
api_keys_agent_check.value: ("api_keys"."kind" = 'agent') = ("api_keys"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("api_keys"."kind" <> 'agent' OR "api_keys"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

api_keys_name_check.name: api_keys_name_check
api_keys_name_check.value: "api_keys"."name" IS NULL OR (char_length("api_keys"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "api_keys"."name" = btrim("api_keys"."name"))

api_keys_personal_check.name: api_keys_personal_check
api_keys_personal_check.value: "api_keys"."kind" <> 'personal' OR ("api_keys"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api_keys"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

catalog_repositories_credential_check.name: catalog_repositories_credential_check
catalog_repositories_credential_check.value:
CASE "catalog_repositories"."auth_kind"
        WHEN 'github_app' THEN "catalog_repositories"."auth" IS NULL AND "catalog_repositories"."credential_source" IS NULL
        WHEN 'none' THEN "catalog_repositories"."auth" IS NULL AND "catalog_repositories"."credential_source" IS NULL
        WHEN 'github_app_explicit' THEN "catalog_repositories"."auth" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_repositories"."credential_source" = 'external'
        ELSE "catalog_repositories"."auth" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_repositories"."credential_source" IN ('stored', 'external')
      END

control_intents_interrupt_target_check.name: control_intents_interrupt_target_check
control_intents_interrupt_target_check.value: "control_intents"."kind" <> 'interrupt' OR ("control_intents"."target_turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "control_intents"."attempt_id" IS NOT NULL)

env_variables_value_check.name: env_variables_value_check
env_variables_value_check.value: ("env_variables"."kind" = 'plain') = ("env_variables"."value" IS NOT NULL) AND ("env_variables"."value" IS NULL OR octet_length("env_variables"."value") <= 49152)

env_variables_allow_automation_check.name: env_variables_allow_automation_check
env_variables_allow_automation_check.value: NOT "env_variables"."allow_automation" OR ("env_variables"."kind" = 'secret' AND "env_variables"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL)

grants_actions_resource_check.name: grants_actions_resource_check
grants_actions_resource_check.value: "grants"."actions" <@ CASE "resource_kind" WHEN 'workspace' THEN ARRAY['workspace.read','workspace.manage','agent.manage','binding.manage','binding.approve','routine.manage','memory.read','memory.write']::text[] WHEN 'session' THEN ARRAY['session.read','session.submit','session.approve','session.control','session.recover','artifact.read','delivery.send']::text[] WHEN 'invite' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] WHEN 'agent' THEN ARRAY['agent.manage','binding.manage','binding.approve','routine.manage','memory.read','memory.write']::text[] WHEN 'agent_release' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] WHEN 'surface_binding' THEN ARRAY['binding.manage','binding.approve','session.submit','delivery.send']::text[] WHEN 'session_link' THEN ARRAY['session.read','session.submit','session.approve','session.control','delivery.send']::text[] WHEN 'dispatch' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] WHEN 'memory' THEN ARRAY['memory.read','memory.write']::text[] WHEN 'routine' THEN ARRAY['routine.manage']::text[] WHEN 'artifact' THEN ARRAY['artifact.read']::text[] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END

grants_id_length_check.name: grants_id_length_check
grants_id_length_check.value: length("grants"."actor_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND ("grants"."service_principal_id" IS NULL OR length("grants"."service_principal_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND length("grants"."resource_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND length("grants"."audience_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 512

linked_accounts_revoked_check.name: linked_accounts_revoked_check
linked_accounts_revoked_check.value: ("linked_accounts"."status" = 'revoked') = ("linked_accounts"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("linked_accounts"."status" = 'revoked') = ("linked_accounts"."revoked_reason" IS NOT NULL)

login_methods_external_check.name: login_methods_external_check
login_methods_external_check.value: CASE WHEN "login_methods"."kind" = 'password' THEN "login_methods"."issuer" IS NULL AND "login_methods"."subject" IS NULL ELSE "login_methods"."issuer" IS NOT NULL AND "login_methods"."subject" IS NOT NULL END

pending_requests_park_due.name: pending_requests_park_due
pending_requests_park_due.where: "pending_requests"."parked_at" IS NULL AND "pending_requests"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "pending_requests"."park_at" IS NOT NULL

pending_requests_undelivered_attempt_idx.name: pending_requests_undelivered_attempt_idx
pending_requests_undelivered_attempt_idx.where: "pending_requests"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pending_requests"."settled_at" IS NULL

pending_requests_approval_check.name: pending_requests_approval_check
pending_requests_approval_check.value: ("pending_requests"."answer_surface" IS NULL) = ("pending_requests"."answer_decision_id" IS NULL) AND ("pending_requests"."answer_surface" IS NULL OR "pending_requests"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pending_requests"."answered_by" IS NULL OR "pending_requests"."answer_surface" IS NOT NULL)

push_intents_shape_check.name: push_intents_shape_check
push_intents_shape_check.value: ("push_intents"."status" NOT IN ('pinned','requested') OR "push_intents"."pinned_revision" IS NOT NULL) AND (("push_intents"."status" = 'requested') = ("push_intents"."push_request_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("push_intents"."status" IN ('failed','cancelled')) = ("push_intents"."refusal_code" IS NOT NULL))

push_requests_decision_check.name: push_requests_decision_check
push_requests_decision_check.value: ("push_requests"."state" = 'requested') = ("push_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("push_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("push_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("push_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("push_requests"."decision_receipt_id" IS NULL)

session_achievements_evidence_uniq.name: session_achievements_evidence_uniq
session_achievements_evidence_uniq.where: "session_achievements"."evidence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session_achievements"."superseded_at" IS NULL

session_achievements_probability_check.name: session_achievements_probability_check
session_achievements_probability_check.value: ("session_achievements"."probability" IS NULL) = ("session_achievements"."judge" = 'always') AND ("session_achievements"."probability" IS NULL OR "session_achievements"."probability" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)

session_repository_attachments_settled_c.name: session_repository_attachments_settled_check
session_repository_attachments_settled_c.value: ("session_repository_attachments"."status" = 'attached') = ("session_repository_attachments"."git_commit" IS NOT NULL) AND ("session_repository_attachments"."status" = 'failed') = ("session_repository_attachments"."failure" IS NOT NULL) AND ("session_repository_attachments"."status" = 'pending') = ("session_repository_attachments"."settled_at" IS NULL)

sessions_spec_check.name: sessions_spec_check
sessions_spec_check.value: ("sessions"."runtime_spec" IS NULL) = ("sessions"."spec_source" IS NULL) AND ("sessions"."runtime_spec" IS NULL) = ("sessions"."spec_source_digest" IS NULL) AND ("sessions"."runtime_spec" IS NULL) = ("sessions"."spec_digest" IS NULL)

sessions_pause_reason_check.name: sessions_pause_reason_check
sessions_pause_reason_check.value: "sessions"."pause_reason" IS NULL OR ("sessions"."pause_reason" IN ('awaiting_input') AND "sessions"."admission_state" IN ('pausing', 'paused'))

sessions_repository_mode_check.name: sessions_repository_mode_check
sessions_repository_mode_check.value: ("sessions"."repository_mode" = 'repository' AND "sessions"."repo_url" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."branch" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sessions"."repository_mode" = 'none' AND "sessions"."repository_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."repo_url" IS NULL AND "sessions"."branch" IS NULL)

slack_apps_created_check.name: slack_apps_created_check
slack_apps_created_check.value: "slack_apps"."state" NOT IN ('created', 'deleting', 'deleted') OR ("slack_apps"."app_id" IS NOT NULL AND "slack_apps"."client_id" IS NOT NULL)

slack_inbound_events_dropped_check.name: slack_inbound_events_dropped_check
slack_inbound_events_dropped_check.value: ("slack_inbound_events"."status" = 'dropped') = ("slack_inbound_events"."drop_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("slack_inbound_events"."status" = 'dropped') = ("slack_inbound_events"."payload" IS NULL)

slack_inbound_events_claim_check.name: slack_inbound_events_claim_check
slack_inbound_events_claim_check.value: ("slack_inbound_events"."claim_token" IS NULL) = ("slack_inbound_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("slack_inbound_events"."status" = 'received' OR "slack_inbound_events"."claim_token" IS NULL)

slack_installations_verified_check.name: slack_installations_verified_check
slack_installations_verified_check.value: "slack_installations"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("slack_installations"."bot_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "slack_installations"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

slack_outbox_settle_idx.name: slack_outbox_settle_idx
slack_outbox_settle_idx.where: "slack_outbox"."kind" = 'input_notice' AND "slack_outbox"."status" = 'sent' AND "slack_outbox"."settle_state" IS DISTINCT FROM 'abandoned' AND ("slack_outbox"."settle_state" IS DISTINCT FROM 'settled' OR "slack_outbox"."settle_uncertain_latest_at" IS NOT NULL)

slack_outbox_claim_check.name: slack_outbox_claim_check
slack_outbox_claim_check.value: ("slack_outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL) = ("slack_outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("slack_outbox"."status" IN ('pending', 'sending') OR "slack_outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL) AND ("slack_outbox"."status" <> 'sending' OR "slack_outbox"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL)

surface_bindings_membership_check.name: surface_bindings_membership_check
surface_bindings_membership_check.value: ("surface_bindings"."membership" IS NULL OR "surface_bindings"."membership" IN ('joined','awaiting_invite','config_error','join_failed')) AND ("surface_bindings"."membership_error" IS NULL OR "surface_bindings"."membership" IS NOT NULL)

surface_bindings_dm_check.name: surface_bindings_dm_check
surface_bindings_dm_check.value: "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'dm' OR ("surface_bindings"."external_surface_id" IS NULL AND NOT "surface_bindings"."home")

surface_bindings_ready_check.name: surface_bindings_ready_check
surface_bindings_ready_check.value: "surface_bindings"."surface" <> 'slack' OR "surface_bindings"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("surface_bindings"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" IS NOT NULL AND ("surface_bindings"."external_surface_id" IS NOT NULL OR "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" = 'dm'))

surface_bindings_pending_check.name: surface_bindings_pending_check
surface_bindings_pending_check.value: "surface_bindings"."status" <> 'pending_approval' OR ("surface_bindings"."surface" = 'slack' AND "surface_bindings"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "surface_bindings"."external_surface_id" IS NOT NULL AND "surface_bindings"."surface_kind" = 'private_channel' AND NOT "surface_bindings"."home")

surface_bindings_left_check.name: surface_bindings_left_check
surface_bindings_left_check.value: "surface_bindings"."status" <> 'left' OR ("surface_bindings"."surface" = 'slack' AND "surface_bindings"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "surface_bindings"."external_surface_id" IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE("surface_bindings"."surface_kind" = 'private_channel', false) AND NOT "surface_bindings"."home" AND "surface_bindings"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "surface_bindings"."approved_lifecycle_us" IS NULL)

worker_launches_open_session_idx.name: worker_launches_open_session_idx
worker_launches_open_session_idx.where: "worker_launches"."slot_released_at" IS NULL AND "worker_launches"."session_id" IS NOT NULL
